name: Campus Bursary: Student Fees & Treasury Control (Excel)
short: Trace student fees from invoice through receipt allocation to bank-settlement exceptions with linked schedules and visible review checks.
description:
Designed for university bursary and treasury teams that need to follow student fee activity without blending separate financial events. Campus Bursary keeps invoice lines, payments, receipt allocations, credits and refunds, and bank settlement matches in separate linked schedules. That makes billed fees, allocated collections, unapplied receipts and settlement exceptions easier to trace without counting a bank settlement as new income.

Use the visible control totals and supporting schedules to find what needs review before a cashier handover or finance report. This macro-free pilot includes clean Excel templates, a fictional demonstration workbook and an operating guide. It does not connect to a bank or automatically approve suggested matches.
features: First-year amount includes annual licence and standard setup
Student records, fee schedules, invoices and instalment dates

Settlement matching with manual review and visible exceptions

Clean customer templates, synthetic demo workbook and user guide

name: Campus Bursary: Budget-to-Payment Control (Excel)
short: Follow budgets, commitments, supplier bills, advances and actuals through reviewable schedules that keep obligations and payments distinct.
description:
Designed for bursary teams that need to see how budgets turn into obligations and actual expenditure. Follow budget revisions and virements, commitments, supplier bills and payments as separate reviewable steps; a supplier bill is expenditure and its payment settles the payable rather than recording another expense. The schedules also cover advances and retirements, restricted-project cash, asset depreciation and payroll period comparison. Payroll comparison checks imported data; it is not a statutory payroll engine.

This macro-free pilot includes clean Excel templates, a fictional demonstration workbook and an operating guide. It targets Microsoft 365 Excel for Windows 64-bit and is designed for one authorised writer at a time. Review institution mappings and controls before financial use.
features: First-year amount includes annual licence and standard setup

name: Campus Bursary: Complete Bursary Control Suite (Excel)
short: Both operational packages plus a Full Suite workbook for manual journals, trial balance and mapped control-account checks.
description:
Bring student revenue and expenditure-control workflows together in one package: both operational workbook sets plus a Full Suite workbook with manual journals, a trial balance and mapped control-account checks. The workbooks use the same source schemas and ID conventions, helping reviewers follow records consistently across schedules. The ledger checks make mapped differences visible, while staff still review the supporting transactions and institution-approved account mappings.

At the approved annual prices, the Full Excel licence is 20% below the combined Package A and Package B licences; the first-year total is also 20% lower. name: Campus Bursary Documents
short: Focused offline Windows software for CSV-validated receipts, student statements and payment vouchers; complements the broader Campus Excel suites.
description:
Version 0.1.1 for Windows 11 x64 on one computer. Stage and validate CSV source records, record source confirmation, prepare reviewed receipts, student account statements and payment vouchers, retain original PDFs and correction history, search locally and create encrypted backups. No activation or institution licence file is required. Core calculations and PDF generation work offline; customer bursary records are not uploaded by default.

This desktop release is a focused document generator, not the broader Campus Excel suites. Package A covers student fees and treasury schedules; Package B covers budgets, commitments, suppliers and expenditure; Full Excel combines those broader areas with mapped ledger checks. It complements rather than replaces the Excel suites or a complete accounting system. Verified paid buyers of Campus Package A, Package B or Full Excel receive version 0.1.1 at no extra charge; use existing purchase access rather than buying it twice.

The approved one-time NGN 200,000 licence is for one institution on one computer and version 0.1.1. Indicative comparison only: about USD 148.11 at the CBN central rate of NGN 1,350.3587 per USD dated 10 November 2026. This is not a USD selling price; checkout is NGN-only and provider or bank rates and fees may differ. The offline application does not enforce a device limit, and downloaded installers can be copied. There is no recurring renewal, ongoing product-use support or later-version updates. Existing BGM purchase/access support and its published seven-day refund policy continue.

This installer is unsigned. Windows may show a publisher warning; do not disable operating-system or antivirus protections. Payment confirmations are recorded from reviewed source records, not independently verified with a bank. This is not a complete accounting system and does not execute payments or grant clearance. Logo import, XLSX mapping, OCR, signature images and automatic updates are not included. Single-computer use does not provide authenticated multi-officer roles.
features: Offline receipts, account statements and payment vouchers
CSV staging with duplicate, date, amount and control-total checks
Reviewed PDF jobs, retained originals and marked copies
Local SQLite records, search and encrypted backups
No licence-file activation or mandatory online check
